description: The RQL guide examples (addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/RqlGuide.cs), run in order by scripts/smoke_rql.py against a live editor. Kept equal to the guide by Godot-MCP.Tests/RqlGuideTests.
query: nodes | where name contains "Enemy" | select $ref name class path
nodes | where $ is Node3D and Position.Y > 0 | select name Position
nodes | where class == "OmniLight3D" | select name props["light_energy"] props["light_color"]
root | recurse children | where childCount == 0 | select path class
console | where logType == "Error" | sort sequence desc | first 5 | select message
mutate: nodes | where class == "OmniLight3D" | set props["light_energy"] = props["light_energy"] * 2, props["light_color"] = "#ffcc88"
nodes | where name starts-with "Enemy" | set Visible = false
